hypotheses.T0_reverse_ce_derivative_matches_forward: Reverse-mode local-write CE gradients match an independent forward JVP to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.T1_energy_prefix512_is_sufficient: The first 512 local-energy modes retain at least 0.95 CE derivative fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.T2_near_full_1024_atlas_is_high_fidelity: All 1,024 learned operator modes retain at least 0.99 CE derivative fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.T3_ce_aware_256_is_sufficient: The fixed CE-aware 256-mode bank retains at least 0.90 on every corpus.
hypotheses.T4_ce_aware_512_is_high_fidelity: The fixed CE-aware 512-mode bank retains at least 0.97 on every corpus.
hypotheses.T5_loss_k90_is_at_most_256: At most 256 CE-aware modes are required to reach 90% fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.T6_tail_program_transfers_ood: At 512 modes, each OOD CE-aware fidelity is within 0.05 of FineWeb.
hypotheses.T7_loss_relevance_strongly_reorders_top2: Fewer than half of the CE-aware top 256 are in the energy-prefix top 256.
hypotheses.T8_spectral_tail_is_behaviorally_materia: The 1,024-mode energy prefix exceeds the 256-mode prefix by at least 0.05 on every corpus.
